  alice  Villager   bob    Villager   carol  Doctor     dave   Werewolf
  erin   Werewolf   frank  Villager   grace  Seer

Night 1  (7 living)
  carol protects alice
  dave  devours alice
  erin  devours bob
  grace investigates bob  ->  Village
  no one died

Day 1  (7 living)
  alice -> frank   bob   -> carol   carol -> bob     dave  -> alice
  erin  -> alice   frank -> grace   grace -> erin
  alice is lynched   (Villager)

Night 2  (6 living)
  carol protects frank
  dave  devours erin
  erin  devours carol
  grace investigates erin  ->  Werewolves
  erin is devoured   (Werewolf)

Day 2  (5 living)
  bob   -> grace   carol -> frank   dave  -> bob     frank -> grace
  grace -> frank
  frank is lynched   (Villager)

Night 3  (4 living)
  carol protects dave
  dave  devours carol
  grace investigates no one
  carol is devoured   (Doctor)

Day 3  (3 living)
  bob   -> dave    dave  -> bob     grace -> dave
  dave is lynched   (Werewolf)

Village wins after 3 rounds.  Survivors: bob, grace
